question: ______ and _____ were the foundation of Ghana's trade in ancient times.
solution:
The correct answer is Gold; salt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage mentions that 'they were known for trading salt for gold from the Soninke'.
 
• The last paragraph of the passage also mentions that 'Ghana had reached its peak in the 10th century. This was the country which controlled both the gold and salt trades'. 
 
• Hence from the above mentioned points we can conclude that 'gold; salt' are the most appropriate words to fill in the blank.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: Gold and Salt were the foundation of Ghana's trade in ancient times.
